scope: opt-in research entry point only; production FGO/SPP defaults unchanged

structural_smoke.role: existing truth-free v2 payload; 20-epoch bounded smoke

train_extension.role: existing train payload; only after structural smoke
train_extension.truth: train-only comparison may be opened only after smoke artifact sealing

gnss_factors: optional motion random walk from existing config
candidate_recipe.carrier_or_doppler_factors: disabled; existing no-base native backend does not insert taroz custom TDCP/Doppler factors
candidate_recipe.pose_state: Pose3 body-in-ENU, zero lever arm, ENU Z-up gravity -9.80665 m/s^2
candidate_recipe.axis_contract: raw Android sensor axes are transformed by explicit identity axis map followed by upstream RzRyRx mounting rotation; no implicit axis assumption
candidate_recipe.imu_units: accelerometer m/s^2; Android gyro rad/s converted once to loader CSV deg/s then back to rad/s
candidate_recipe.timestamp_contract: GPST week/TOW; UTC milliseconds from Android are converted with the declared 18 s GPS-UTC offset; no estimated offset is applied at solve time
candidate_recipe.imu_sync: gyro timestamps are anchors; accelerometer nearest pairing is the existing 25 ms schema adapter contract
candidate_recipe.gravity_alignment: fusion_initialization::alignStatic after explicit mounting rotation; reject nonfinite/zero window
candidate_recipe.heading_alignment: GNSS seed displacement over 25 epochs, horizontal speed 2..50 m/s, |up|<=3 m/s, three consistent windows within 20 deg; otherwise yaw remains unobserved and output falls back
candidate_recipe.fallback: if IMU schema, attitude observability, geometry, finite state, or solver checks fail, run the exact same no-base problem without IMU and mark native-fgo-v1 fallback; never synthesize a coordinate

references.use: preintegration parameters, Pose3/velocity/bias graph, CombinedImuFactor loop, ENU output
published IMU noise, mounting rotation, sync policy
audited but not copied; custom no-base factor remains deferred

implementation_boundary.source_policy: no upstream source copied into production; cache is hash-pinned and local adapter is isolated

promotion: structural smoke and unchanged train comparison are required; production defaults and Kaggle lane remain unchanged
